title: 2008 Upper Deck First Edition Starquest Common #SQ-33 Alex Rodriguez NY Yankees
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2008 Upper Deck First Edition Starquest Common #SQ-33 trading card features the legendary Alex Rodriguez of the New York Yankees. The card is a must-have for any Major League Baseball (MLB) fan and collector, with its elegant design and rare features. 

The card is not autographed, but it is an excellent addition to any sports trading card collection. The set is manufactured by Upper Deck, a reputable and skilled manufacturer of sports memorabilia. This card is a parallel/variety and an insert, making it a unique and valuable addition to your collection. Get your hands on this rare Alex Rodriguez trading card today!
